0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Phoenix Suns visit the Portland Trail Blazers. For the Suns, Mark Williams is out with shoulder surgery recovery and Luke Kennard is day-to-day with a knee strain and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), with Deni Avdija (ankle) and Micah Potter (illness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but their most recent meeting was a 92-77 loss to Portland in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
